author: CMLSC
body:
I managed to make 2 maps in one day. XD I just didn't get to posting this one. :P
My other one(still not accepted or denied): https://avicus.net/forums/discussions/304918447

Map Name: Reborn

Map Creator: CMLSC and jerbear64 (he helped me with 2 islands. :P)

Map Download: I will add this if it looks like it will be accepted.

YAML: I will also add this if it looks like it will be accepted. (15v15 teams with names Zombies and Ghosts)

Images:

Overview(monuments are in the corners as part of the trees with trapdoors on them):


There are diamonds here, but only on the walls. No further.


There are two paths connecting the middle and front islands to let players easily get to the middle one. There is also one wide bridge in the middle where there will be a lot of pvp on the defensive side.


The spawn area is a bit small, but it helps defensively because you have to bridge or go through the spawn to get to the monument. Anything going through there is guaranteed to be seen too. This prevents those 5 minute games and forces players to rush in groups or bridge.


These towers are here to slow down players, one has ladders and the other has a staircase.



This bridge is actually a trap. It makes players go near the spawn on a thin bridge where they can easily be shot off.

I hope you like my map! :D
~CMLSC

replies.author: ProfessorUtonium
replies.body:
I am sorry to say but your map, Reborn, has been denied for testing on the Avicus Network.

To Improve your map, the map developers suggest that you make the map smaller and make the paths more definite. THey are awkward and redundant. The block choices are also weird. The concept is unique but the map needs to be improved. There is also a lot of diamonds and with those, the map won't play well.


If you have any other questions on how to improve your map, Find me on TeamSpeak or Message me on Skype (Sethskye).


You may resubmit your map once edited.
